parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the instance. Set this parameter to `true` to enable this feature, or `false` to disable it.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The hostname of the instance. The hostname must be 2 to 64 characters in length. You can use periods to separate the name into segments. Each segment can contain letters, digits, and hyphens. The hostname cannot start or end with a period or a hyphen, and it cannot contain consecutive periods or hyphens.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. You can modify only one instance per request.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description:
The name of the instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description:
The Base64-encoded user data for the instance.

The Raw Data cannot exceed 16 KB in size. Do not pass Sensitive Information, such as passwords and private keys, in plaintext. If you must pass sensitive information, encrypt and then Base64-encode it. You can then decode and decrypt this data from within the instance.
